consumer: pick_up_from_items in src/pickup.cpp, which presents the ground-item pile as an interactive menu and asks the player which items to select for pickup, finalizing on CONFIRM through ctxt.handle_input()
scope: the ground-item stacks reachable for pickup at the nearby tile(s) (map::i_at pickup pile), not the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::pick_up_from_items — registers UP/DOWN/RIGHT/CONFIRM/QUIT and runs an input loop (ctxt.handle_input()) that marks the selection and finalizes it, i.e. it PRESENTS a menu and performs the choice through the real active input loop
divergence: A pile of 3 ground items where the player intends to take only item #2: a shortcut that picks up all items (or item #1 by default) instead of routing the UP/DOWN/CONFIRM selection through the menu loop ends with the wrong items in inventory, exposing the wrong authority
